flows.name: 第二批夜间：绑定与数值格式复核（单位、千分位，T04 与 08-03）

steps.eval: (() => { const sels = ["[data-question-other=\"template_edit_confirm\"] .question-other-input","[data-question-text=\"template_edit_request\"] .question-text-input"]; let n = 0; for (const sel of sels) { for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(sel)) { if (el.value) { el.value = ''; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); n += 1; } } } return n >= 0; })()

steps.text: 生成 A 机房昨日能耗日报，报表里要有这五个板块，标题就用我写的名字：第一个板块标题「日报说明」，是说明文字；第二个板块标题「昨日总耗电」，是指标卡；第三个板块标题「设备耗电明细」，是明细表，列出设备名称和耗电量；第四个板块标题「设备耗电排名」，是柱状图，横轴设备名称、纵轴耗电量；第五个板块标题「昨日逐小时耗电趋势」，是折线图。

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.plan-action-select'); const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '确认方案'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.text: 把「昨日总耗电」指标卡改为显示当前区域已有结果中的「运行设备数」，单位用台。

steps.eval: (async () => { const sel = ".question-select[data-question-id=\"pending_edit_plan_confirm\"]:not([disabled])"; const deadline = Date.now() + 25000; while (Date.now() < deadline) {   const s = document.querySelector(sel);   if (s && !s.disabled) {     const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改');     if (opt) { s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; }   }   await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return false; })()

(() => { const label = document.querySelector('#preview-root .wtm-metric-label'); const value = document.querySelector('#preview-root .wtm-metric-value'); return Boolean(label && label.textContent.trim() === '运行设备数' && value && value.textContent.includes('台')); })()

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.text: 把当前显示「运行设备数」的这张指标卡临时改为显示当前区域已有结果中的「昨日总耗电」，名称改为「耗电格式验证」，单位用 kWh。先保留一位小数，关闭千分位。不要修改结果数据。

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="pending_edit_plan_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const label = document.querySelector('#preview-root .wtm-metric-label'); const value = document.querySelector('#preview-root .wtm-metric-value'); if (!label || !value) return false; const t = value.textContent; return label.textContent.trim() === '耗电格式验证' && t.includes('kWh') && !t.includes('台') && /\d/.test(t); })()

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.text: 把「耗电格式验证」指标卡的数值格式改成整数，并加上千分位，数值绑定和单位标签保持不变。

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="pending_edit_plan_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const value = document.querySelector('#preview-root .wtm-metric-value'); if (!value) return false; const t = value.textContent; return t.includes(',') && t.includes('kWh') && !/\.\d/.test(t.replace(/\d,/g, '')); })()

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.text: 把「耗电格式验证」指标卡恢复为显示当前区域已有结果中的「运行设备数」，名称改回「运行设备数」，单位用台，保留整数和千分位格式。

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="pending_edit_plan_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const label = document.querySelector('#preview-root .wtm-metric-label'); const value = document.querySelector('#preview-root .wtm-metric-value'); if (!label || !value) return false; return label.textContent.trim() === '运行设备数' && value.textContent.includes('台'); })()
